mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher wage growth expectations, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month
failure_condition: In regimes with PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly increases, 60-day forward returns are negative on average (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 3% signals robust demand, which is associated with higher corporate earnings forecasts and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 100 observations with GDPC1 > 3%, 20-day forward returns are not positive (median ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 (monthly) indicates supply-side contraction, which raises production costs and reduces S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During INDPRO < 50 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the tightened policy discount rate increases the present value of future dividends, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the current month
failure_condition: In months with FEDFUNDS > 4%, 20-day forward returns are not negative (mean ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE unemployment below 4.0% (from 4.1% or higher) reflects labor market softening, which is associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% and remains below for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 200 instances where UNRATE < 4.0% for ≥ 60 days, 60-day forward returns are not positive (median ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 and HOUST retail sales above 2% each act in tandem to signal robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > +2% AND HOUST > +2% in the same month
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed +2% monthly, 20-day forward returns are not positive (mean ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: A regime where RSAFS ( inventories) rises by more than 10% month-over-month indicates excess supply, which is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >10% from prior month
failure_condition: During months with RSAFS > +10% change, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).
